summary: Handle String.prototype.matchAll through the JavaScript-compatible RegExp/runtime layer.

target.notes: JavaScript RegExp syntax/flags, Symbol hooks, lastIndex interactions, captures, Unicode sets, and result shapes are not equivalent to System.Text.RegularExpressions.

semantics.regexp: ECMAScript RegExp semantics and Symbol protocol
semantics.edge: RegExp argument must be global or TypeError; result is a lazy iterator with match metadata

caveats: System.Text.RegularExpressions differs in grammar, Unicode behavior, captures, backtracking details, and flags.

tests.name: symbol hook or flag edge
tests.expected_behavior: invokes the custom Symbol hook when defined
